issues.title: Low contrast unchecked state
issues.description: Unchecked checkbox indicators have insufficient contrast against dark glass background.
issues.evidence: Unchecked boxes beside Desktop alerts, Prefer reduced transparency, and Telemetry are nearly invisible.
issues.suggestion: Increase stroke contrast for unchecked checkbox borders in dark mode.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: in dark theme --input resolves to rgb(42 41 38) (neutral-200) which is ~1.26:1 against the dark glass panel, so unchecked borders are nearly invisible; fixed by scoping the unchecked border to muted-foreground (neutral-500, ~5.4:1) in dark via dark:data-[state=unchecked]:not-aria-invalid:border-muted-foreground in checkbox.tsx.

issues.title: Checkbox icon vertically centered on multi-line text
issues.description: Checkboxes with description text center the indicator across both lines instead of aligning to the first line.
issues.evidence: The checkboxes for 'Export @2x assets' and 'Optimize file size' sit vertically centered beside the two-line text blocks.
issues.suggestion: Set vertical alignment to top or align with the label line-height.
issues.triageNote: Alignment is decided by the consuming layout: ui/field.tsx FIELD_ORIENTATION_CLASSES.horizontal uses 'flex-row items-center' (line 62), which centers the 16px Checkbox against the whole label+description block; Checkbox itself sets no alignment. Root cause lives in src/components/ui/field.tsx (ui:field) and the flagged instance is in the frozen eval page pair-015 — recommend ui:field switch horizontal to items-start (or add an align prop).

issues.title: RTL text punctuation inversion
issues.description: Helper descriptions display inverted punctuation due to forced RTL direction on English text.
issues.evidence: Leading periods appear before text lines like .Notify me and .Every workspace member.
issues.suggestion: Set dir="auto" or apply bidi isolation to localized string containers.
issues.triageNote:
The Checkbox renders no text; the inverted periods come from English copy in the eval page's own SettingRow

under dir=rtl (bidi-inherent to the page composition, same artifact hit ds:UserMessage on the same page). Fix would be dir="auto"/bdi on the page copy, which lives in the frozen eval page.
